COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.2061 of 2023
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Pranav Singh, learned counsel for the petitioner.
2. Mr. Aakash Suyal, learned counsel holding brief of 
Mr. Aditya Singh, learned Additional Chief Standing 
Counsel for the State of U.P./respondent nos.1 to 4.
3. Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, learned Additional Chief 
Standing Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand/respondent 
no.5.
4. It is the case of the petitioner that petitioner is the 
widow of Late Rodha Ram Sharma, who retired on 
31.01.1987, from Vigilance Department, Sector Dehradun 
from erstwhile State of Uttar Pradesh. Husband of the 
petitioner expired on 13.03.2020.
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that 
pension of the petitioner has been revised, but due to 
mistake on the part of respondent, the letter of revision of 
the pension of the petitioner’s husband instead of being sent 
to respondent no.5, the said letter was dispatched to 
respondent no.4. Consequently, petitioner is not getting her 
revised pension by respondent no.3.
6. Learned counsel for the State of U.P. is directed 
either to show-cause or to pay revised pension to the 
petitioner within a period of three weeks’ from today.
7. List this case on 12.12.2023.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 08.11.2023
SK

Mr. Pranav Singh, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. I.D. Paliwal, learned Additional C.S.C. for 
the State of U.P.
3. Mr. Maneesh Bisht, learned Brief Holder for the 
State of Uttarakhand.
4. This Court, vide order dated 08.11.2023, 
directed the respondents either to release the revised 
pension in favour of the petitioner or to show cause 
within a period of three weeks. However, till date, 
neither has the revised pension been released in 
favour of the petitioner nor have the respondents filed 
any counter affidavit or shown any cause for non￾compliance of the said order.
5. This is a very sorry state of affairs.
6. Let the matter be listed on 07.09.2026 after 
fresh cases, keeping in view the age of the petitioner.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.)

Nos.1 to 4.
3. Mr. Bhupendra Singh Koranga, 
learned Brief Holder for the State of 
Uttarakhand/respondent No.5.
4. This writ petition has been filed by 
petitioner seeking revised pension of her 
husband.
5. Both the petitioner’s counsel as well 
as counsel for State of U.P. are ad idem 
that pension has been revised but the 
same has wrongly been sent to 
respondent No.4-Chief Treasurer, 
Saharanpur, State of Uttar Pradesh, 
while it should have been sent to 
respondent No.5-Sub-Treasurer, 
Roorkee, District Haridwar.
6. Learned Additional C.S.C. for the 
State of U.P. is directed to get the 
mistake rectified within two weeks from 
today and to send the revised pension to 
respondent No.5. 7. Put up on 23.09.2026 after fresh 
cases.
8. Meanwhile, petitioner shall move 
amendment application to correct the 
name of parties.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 07.09.2026
